cream_nugg: Zeno "Lucky" Nugg reported to R-R9 with a lucky button sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Zeno "Lucky" Nugg helped stack spare sandbags at R-R9. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
dababyislike: On Day 9, Zeno "Spark" Dababyislike arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In T-S11, Zeno "Spark" Dababyislike listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
dtbutikof: The old hands of R-S5 have been here since Day 1. Quentin Dtbutikof has been here since Day 7. In a trench, that difference already feels like years. Quentin Dtbutikof reported for duty as a field cook. The new kit was heavier than the explanation of how to use it.

A letter reached Quentin Dtbutikof from Wyvern Cross. The streets there still have names. He read them out loud, one by one. Mail came up the line with a letter for Quentin Dtbutikof. Quentin Dtbutikof read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Otto Tyner wrote a letter for Quentin Dtbutikof's mother, because Quentin could not find the words. Quentin signed it. Mail came up the line with a letter for Quentin Dtbutikof. Quentin Dtbutikof read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Quentin Dtbutikof bought War Bonds for the front. The quartermaster pinned the ribbon on personally: 'The front remembers who kept it fed.'

Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Quentin Dtbutikof watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work. Mail came up the line with a letter for Quentin Dtbutikof. Quentin Dtbutikof read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
hay_ant_hud: Roland "Ash" Hud left a fiancée who wears his ring on a chain behind in Rosenau and came up the line with a cracked shaving mirror. The men noticed at once that he talks to his rifle.
Roland "Ash" Hud was in the first hundred. The old hands in R-F10 call them 'the early birds', and not always kindly.
The sergeant read out the order: Verdel Ridge has fallen, hold the line. Roland "Ash" Hud looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
A clear shot from R-F10. Roland "Ash" Hud badly wounded Nils Averelle and slid back down below the parapet.

A sniper's bullet hit Roland "Ash" Hud at R-F10. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Anselm "Parson" Rock of the Concord (@rotrek_rock). A bed came free in the hospital dugout, and Roland "Ash" Hud was carried in at last. Roland "Ash" Hud opened his eyes today and asked for water. At R-F10 they cheered when the news came up the line.

Roland "Ash" Hud slept most of the day. When he woke, someone had left a cup of tea on the crate beside the bed. Hill 304 has been won. Roland "Ash" Hud listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Roland "Ash" Hud never saw the inside of the aid post. The medics changed his dressings on the stretcher until the wound closed. He is back on the line.
Roland "Ash" Hud fired at a movement across the wire at R-F10. The man went down: Rafael "Button" Superfeisty, gravely wounded.
The patrol came back one man at a time. Roland "Ash" Hud held the gap open and counted until the corporal said that was everyone.
The sergeant at R-F10 called out a range and a spot. Roland "Ash" Hud was the only one who hit it. Wendel Superfeisty was grazed.

The Concord sentry, Pavel "Tin" Satan, shouted once. Roland "Ash" Hud silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@commander.satan) Roland "Ash" Hud came back from the raid with mud to the eyebrows and an enemy helmet as a souvenir. Nobody heard the Concord raiders cut the wire. Roland "Ash" Hud only heard boots on the duckboards at R-F10, then nothing but pain. Raider: Valentin Carlson of the Concord (@nicholas_carlson). The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Roland "Ash" Hud helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
joshhposh: Teodor Joshhposh arrived with the Day 9 draft, carrying a book with the last pages torn out and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.
Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Teodor Joshhposh could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
local_distinguished_person: Oskar "Spark" Person reported to S-F16 with a bullet that missed him sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
The transfer made Oskar "Spark" Person a chaplain. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.

Thunder all night. Oskar "Spark" Person kept flinching. The old hands said that is how you tell the new ones: they flinch at God. Verdel Ridge is in Concord hands. Oskar "Spark" Person stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Oskar "Spark" Person traded for a better blanket and got a reputation as a sharp dealer. The man who lost it wants a rematch.

Oskar "Spark" Person was peppered by shell splinters at S-F16. A medic picked them out one by one while the next salvo came in. A letter from home reached Oskar "Spark" Person before dusk. Oskar "Spark" Person read it twice and slept a little easier.

Oskar "Spark" Person crawled out with the wiring party. When a flare went up, he lay still and counted to ten. The wire at S-F16 holds again. The medics cleaned Oskar "Spark" Person's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at S-F16. Hill 304 has been won. Oskar "Spark" Person listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

Oskar "Spark" Person borrowed a serial novel from a newspaper bundle. The instalment ends with a locked door and a pistol shot. The next issue is missing. A letter from home reached Oskar "Spark" Person before dusk. Oskar "Spark" Person read it twice and slept a little easier.
Oskar "Spark" Person has asked three carrying parties for the next instalment. So far, the search has produced racing results and an advertisement for boots.

Oskar "Spark" Person watched fog gather on the wire until every strand carried beads of water. The sentry beside him called it expensive fencing. Now serving as a rifleman, Oskar "Spark" Person discovered that being experienced at the front did not prevent being new at the job.
Oskar "Spark" Person and Valentin Thky made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it.

At S-F16 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Oskar "Spark" Person turned around and took a shovel blow. Ulrich "Bones" Cocac of the Concord was already gone. Raider: Ulrich "Bones" Cocac of the Concord (@noel_cocac). Victory at Blackwater Canal. Oskar "Spark" Person let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
mvuisak: Pavel Mvuisak stepped off the supply cart at R-F17 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.

Bastian Xiii had Pavel Mvuisak of the Concord in his sights at Verdel Ridge for a long second. Pavel Mvuisak was lighting a pipe. Bastian Xiii let the match burn all the way down. Pavel Mvuisak walked the captured trenches of Verdel Ridge and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Rafael "Button" Superfeisty fixed the strap on Pavel Mvuisak's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut.
Pavel Mvuisak lost a boot to the mud at R-F17. It took two men and a rifle sling to get it back. The mud kept the sock.

Pavel Mvuisak had a letter from home. He read it four times and then once more out loud, for the men who never get any. A letter from home found Pavel Mvuisak before the night shift. Pavel Mvuisak folded it small and kept it close. News of the loss of Hill 304 reached R-F17 with the rations. Pavel Mvuisak ate while listening to the revised orders.

At roll call, Pavel Mvuisak's place stayed empty. Someone said another section might have taken him in. A runner was sent to ask. A letter from home found Pavel Mvuisak before the night shift. Pavel Mvuisak folded it small and kept it close.

The missing report was still on the desk when Pavel Mvuisak walked in. The clerk crossed it out hard enough to tear the paper. A letter from home found Pavel Mvuisak before the night shift. Pavel Mvuisak folded it small and kept it close.

The cook asked for an honest opinion of the stew. Pavel Mvuisak asked if second helpings depended on the answer. A letter from home found Pavel Mvuisak before the night shift. Pavel Mvuisak folded it small and kept it close.

Pavel Mvuisak was hit in the hip at R-F17. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Gideon "Mud" Cubes of the Hegemony (@sugar_cubes745). Pavel Mvuisak stood up to fix a loose sandbag at R-F17. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Gideon "Mud" Cubes of the Hegemony (@sugar_cubes745).
Felix Mvuisak put a lock of hair in a matchbox beside the bunk. Someone who had known Pavel Mvuisak helped clear the shelf without saying why.

Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Felix Mvuisak watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper. A letter from home found Felix Mvuisak before the night shift. Felix Mvuisak folded it small and kept it close.
rakan_1027: Anselm Rakan arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a letter he never sent and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.

Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Anselm Rakan kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand. A letter from home reached Anselm Rakan before dusk. Anselm Rakan read it twice and slept a little easier.
stry_61: Severin Stry stepped off the supply cart at S-C7 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.

On Day 10, Blackwater Canal passed to the Hegemony. Severin Stry wrote the name in his diary with unusual care. Mail came up the line with a letter for Severin Stry. Severin Stry read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
tegan_baumann: Otto Baumann joined the replacements on Day 9. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at R-C3 changed before the cheering ended. Otto Baumann shouldered another load.
thurmansuper: On Day 9 Gustav Thurmansuper took a post at R-R10 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He talks to his rifle, and the men liked him for it.

Gustav Thurmansuper was hit through the chest at R-R10. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Dorian "Whistle" Aversa of the Hegemony (@aariele_aversa). Gustav Thurmansuper recognized the orderly today and said the orderly's name out loud. The surgeon says he will pull through. The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In R-R10, Gustav Thurmansuper listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
wyatthohbein: "You're late," said the corporal when Zeno "Owl" Wyatthohbein arrived on Day 9. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."

Zeno "Owl" Wyatthohbein was carrying water up to S-R17 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Zeno "Owl" Wyatthohbein did not. Shot by Albin Jib of the Concord (@jai_jib). Zeno "Owl" Wyatthohbein was killed on watch at S-R17. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Albin Jib of the Concord (@jai_jib).
The House of Wyatthohbein sent Bram "Parson" Wyatthohbein after Zeno "Owl" Wyatthohbein. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
